[img]https://i.imgur.com/Z4GOv8H.png[/img] When a pawn from an enemy faction dies it adds to a cooldown timer for the faction to be able to raid again. By default, each death adds 12 hours, up to a maximum of 360 hours (15 days). The amount of time per death and maximum cooldown are configurable through the mod settings menu. This is essentially a light-weight version of my older mod: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2006644524]Faction Resources[/url].
[h1]Extra Features[/h1] [list] [*]Maximum cooldown time and time added per death are configurable. [*]Option to display a faction's current cooldown on the faction screen. [/list]
[h1]Recommended Mods[/h1] Highly recommended to use with [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2006638530]Enemy Self Preservation[/url]. Without it, enemy factions will take greater losses during raids and lead to higher average cooldown times.
[h1]Mod Compatibility[/h1] [list] [*]Not compatible with [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2006644524]Faction Resources[/url]. [*]Maybe compatible with [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2222935097]Rim War[/url]? [/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/PwoNOj4.png[/img] [list] [*] See if the error persists if you just have this mod and its requirements active. [*] If not, try adding your other mods until it happens again. [*] Post your error-log using the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2873415404]Log Uploader[/url] or the standalone [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2873415404]Uploader[/url] and command Ctrl+F12 [*] For best support, please use the Discord-channel for error-reporting. [*] Do not report errors by making a discussion-thread, I get no notification of that. [*] If you have the solution for a problem, please post it to the GitHub repository. [*] Use [url=https://github.com/RimSort/RimSort/releases/latest]RimSort[/url] to sort your mods [/list]
